name: Shirox+
subtitle: Personal anime & manga library manager for iOS
description:
Shirox+ is a free, source-available personal anime & manga library manager for iOS 15+.

Organize and track your anime and manga collection using community-built modules. AniList and MyAnimeList integration for library management and discovery. Full Reading Mode for manga with dedicated reader, schedule, and settings.

apps.name: Shirox+
apps.subtitle: Personal anime & manga library manager for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
Shirox+ is a free, source-available personal anime & manga library manager for iOS 15+.

• Organize your anime and manga collection with community-built modules
• AniList and MyAnimeList integration for library management and discovery
• Full Reading Mode for manga with dedicated reader
• Continue Watching / Continue Reading: pick up right where you left off
• Picture-in-Picture and AirPlay support
• Subtitle support
• Manga schedule with chapter release tracking
• Unified History system for anime and manga

versions.localizedDescription: Fixed: Anime and manga poster status text now uses one unified format — status and count always shown together, comma-separated ("Airing, 8", "Finished, 12"), same size/font/position on every poster — replacing the old either/or logic that showed an episode count on some posters and a bare status word on others. For airing titles the count is the number of episodes/chapters released so far (derived from AniList's nextAiringEpisode for anime, from the live chapters count for manga), not the announced total. Fixed: Schedule section notification bell icon was still a tiny bit offset to the right across rows. Root cause: the on/off states swapped between two SF Symbols ("bell.fill" vs "bell.badge.fill") whose bounding boxes differ — centered in the same 32×32 frame, the wider badged variant shifted the visible bell a couple of points on rows with notifications enabled, so on/off rows never formed a perfectly straight line. The bell glyph is now always "bell.fill" (identical position on every row) with the on-state badge drawn as a small dot overlaid at the bell's top-right shoulder — zero offset, and poster alignment/positioning completely untouched.

Fixed: Schedule section notification bell icon was being pushed off the right edge of the screen. Root cause: the v2.4 fix added an OUTER .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading) modifier on the ScheduleCard body (after .padding/.background) which expanded the view's frame but allowed the inner HStack's natural width to grow unbounded — combined with the inner VStack's own .frame(maxWidth: .infinity), this caused the HStack to claim more horizontal space than the row actually had, pushing the bell past the right edge. Removed the redundant OUTER .frame modifier (kept the inner VStack's .frame(maxWidth: .infinity) which is sufficient to anchor the poster to the leading edge and let the bell sit at the trailing edge naturally). Also removed the redundant .frame(width: 32, height: 32) on the bell Button itself (the inner Image already has the same frame). MangaScheduleCard got the same cleanup.

Fixed: Schedule section posters were still appearing in different horizontal positions for certain entries (e.g. ONA-format shows) — the LazyVStack defaulted to center alignment, so any card whose NavigationLink didn't fully expand would get centered instead of leading-aligned. Added explicit alignment: .leading to both LazyVStacks (anime schedule + manga schedule) and .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading) to each NavigationLink row so every card fills the full row width and anchors to the leading edge regardless of its content.

Fixed: Schedule section posters and notification bell icons are now perfectly aligned in a single straight line on every row — no per-card horizontal drift. Both ScheduleCard (anime) and MangaScheduleCard now have an explicit .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading) on the outer body so the HStack fills the full row width, plus a double .frame(width: 84, height: 112) wrapper around the poster and an explicit .frame(width: 32, height: 32) on the bell Button so their layout contribution is identical on every row.
Fixed: Anime detail page poster now pulls from AniList's coverImage (extraLarge ?? large), matching the Home screen and long-press context menu preview. Previously the detail page used TVDBPosterImage which could show a different TVDB-sourced poster than the rest of the app.
Fixed: Manga detail page section order now matches the anime detail page — Characters and Recommendations sections appear BEFORE the chapter list (some manga have 100+ chapters, so this keeps these sections reachable without an extremely long scroll). Previously they appeared after the chapter list.
Added: Anime posters on Home now display the same small status text in the bottom-left corner that manga posters show — episode count (e.g. "12 ep") when episodes are populated, otherwise the status string (e.g. "Airing"). Matches the MangaPosterCard pattern exactly.

Fixed: All ratings now display out of 10 (e.g. "7.5") instead of as a percentage (e.g. "75%"). Applied app-wide — Home (anime + manga), Library grid + list, anime detail, manga detail, search results, recommendations, notification detail, and the "Rating" info row on every detail page. No more percentage-format ratings remain anywhere.
Fixed: Schedule section posters were horizontally misaligned across cards (some slightly left, some slightly right). Applied the same alignment pattern already used by the notification section — the text column now absorbs all available width so the poster stays pinned to the leading edge and the bell stays pinned to the trailing edge on every card.
Removed: Auto Pick loading overlay/spinner — no loading animation. Auto Pick runs silently and starts playback directly when a stream is found.

Fixed: Auto Pick playback not starting — the stream was selected in the logs but the player never received it because the Change Stream sheet's onDismiss callback was bypassed. Now calls selectStream() directly.
Fixed: Auto Pick 30-second freeze — added a progress overlay showing current step (Trying…, Searching…, Fetching streams…, Starting playback…).
Fixed: Schedule detail poster overflow — added .clipped() to prevent the hero image from extending past the left screen edge.

Fixed: Manga cache key mismatch — standardized limit=25 across all manga top/manga call sites so they share cache/dedup benefit.
Improved: Section-level 'temporarily unavailable' UI state — when both AniList and Jikan fail for manga, shows a clear message instead of blank/spinner. Applied to manga Browse, Schedule, and Search.
Manga 504 errors are confirmed as a Jikan-side issue (anime works, manga doesn't). App's request behavior and error handling are now fixed.

Fixed: Jikan request storm — multiple screens were independently calling the same Jikan endpoints simultaneously, tripping the 3 req/sec rate limit and causing cascading 429/504 failures. Added a shared request layer with: (1) in-flight deduplication, (2) 120-second result cache, (3) app-wide 400ms rate limiting between requests. Retries are now handled centrally instead of per call site.

Fixed: Jikan 502/504 fallback failures — now retries once after 3s instead of immediately failing. Increased 429 backoff from 1s to 2s.
Fixed: MAL token refresh spam for unauthenticated users — short-circuits immediately if no refresh token exists.
Fixed: Search manga fallback — manga search now falls back to Jikan when AniList is unavailable.
Improved: Jikan 5xx retries are logged with endpoint + status. Backoff/retry limited to once.

Fixed: Manga and Schedule not loading when AniList is down (403 'API temporarily disabled'). Added Jikan/MAL fallback for the manga schedule tab (was missing). Added topRated to manga home Jikan fallback. Jikan fallback errors are now logged.
AniList's 403 is a server-side issue — the API itself is down. The app falls back to Jikan/MAL. When AniList comes back, pull-to-refresh switches back automatically.

Fixed: Library Grid icon restored to top-right toolbar (was incorrectly in filter row).
Fixed: Schedule poster left-edge clipping — now uses safe area horizontal padding.
Fixed: Auto Pick duplicate execution — added state guard preventing multiple simultaneous Auto Pick operations. Each gets a unique request ID. Duplicate triggers are logged and ignored.
Improved: Auto Pick logging includes request ID for tracing.

Fixed: Library alignment — Grid/List toggle moved back into filter row so it aligns with Sort capsule. Was in nav bar causing drift.
Fixed: Auto Pick Module now actually works — when ON, automatically selects module + stream using priority list and quality preferences. No Change Stream UI shown. Falls back through modules in order. Detailed logging added.
When Auto Pick is OFF (default), manual workflow is unchanged.

Fixed: Manga section not loading due to AniList 429 rate-limit errors. Added 90-second rate-limit cooldown so the app stops hammering AniList when rate-limited. Manga and anime home now fall back to MAL/Jikan when AniList is rate-limited.

Fixed: Schedule posters being cut off on the left — restored navigation title so safe area insets are correct.
Fixed: Duplicate Auto Pick settings — now only one entry point (NavigationLink to full settings page).
Investigated: 403/502 playback errors are provider-side failures, not app bugs. Normal manual playback is unaffected by Auto Pick when OFF (default).

Added: Auto Pick Module Settings page with module priority tier list, preferred quality/audio/subtitles/stream type, fallback settings, and collapsible sections. Clearly marked as Experimental — disabled by default.
Changed: Search History is now its own section — no longer shown under search results. Surprise Me becomes a small icon in the history header.
The normal manual workflow (Episode → Choose Module → Choose Stream → Watch) is unchanged.

Fixed: Schedule poster alignment — cards now have a fixed title height so different title lengths don't break the grid.
Added: Update Status card in Settings → About — shows 'You're up to date' or 'Update Available' with a Check for Updates button.

Added: Up Next smart auto-play card in player (10-second countdown, Play Now, dismiss).
Added: Auto-Download New Episodes + Download Over WiFi Only (Settings → Downloads).
Added: Watch Time Statistics dashboard in Profile (episodes, time, streaks, top 5 anime).
Added: Continue Watching countdown badge (next episode airing timer).
Added: Show Next Episode Countdown, Auto-Fallback, Auto Pick Module (Testing) toggles in Settings → Streaming.
The normal manual workflow (Episode → Choose Module → Choose Stream → Watch) is unchanged. All new toggles are OFF by default except the countdown.

Added: Storage Management page (Settings → Storage) — see download sizes and bulk-delete.
Added: Per-Show Playback Settings — player remembers your speed per anime. Settings → Streaming has clear instructions.
Added: Module Health Indicators — colored status dots on each module (green/yellow/red/orange).
Added: Episode Release Notifications UI — toggles now have descriptive subtitles.

Final polish pass.

Fixed: 4 glow leaks on episode/chapter row badges — now properly gated by the Glow setting.
Fixed: Duplicate AniList API request in CharactersSection — now uses the MAL ID from the parent instead of re-fetching.
Removed: 605 lines of dead code (CustomActionSheet.swift + DownloadModulePickerView old implementations).
Improved: Download retry now uses exponential backoff (2s→4s→8s→16s→32s) instead of retrying immediately.

Added: Manual number input in Download Range — type episode/chapter numbers directly (e.g. 50 → 53).
Fixed: Download now opens the new custom Change Stream UI (same as Watch / Change Stream flow) instead of the old default iOS List picker.
Fixed: Collection (bookmark) icon color — was rendering white; now uses the accent color when saved.
Changed: Episode labels now show 'EP N' instead of 'Episode N' everywhere. Manga unchanged.

Added: Download Range feature for Anime — pick a start and end episode (e.g. 50→53) to download a range. Custom UI with +/- buttons, sliders, and quick presets (First 5, First 10, Last 5, Last 10, Entire Series). Already-downloaded episodes are skipped automatically.
Added: Download Range feature for Manga — same custom range picker for manga chapters. Pick a start and end chapter to download a range.
The range UI is fully custom (no Apple default pickers). Anime uses Episodes, Manga uses Chapters — completely separated.

Fixed: Staff section now loads actual staff data from AniList (was failing because Jikan API was rate-limited). Staff names, images, and roles appear correctly.
Fixed: Glow toggle — when OFF, no glow is visible anywhere. When ON, no glow on text. Updates immediately without restart.
Reverted: Custom Long Action UI (back to standard context menu).
Reverted: Custom Player UI collapsible settings (back to single bottom bar).

Added: Custom Long Action UI — long-press an anime poster to see a custom action sheet with poster, title, score, and action cards (Add to Planning, Add to Watching, Mark as Completed). Matches the Change Stream UI design. No more Apple default context menu.
Added: Collapsible Player Settings — Source, Quality, Audio, Subtitles, and Playback Speed are now hidden behind a single toggle button. Main controls (Fullscreen, Next Episode) stay visible.
Changed: Blue is now the default theme (was red).
Changed: Random Anime (Surprise Me) now uses genres — picks 4 random genres and fetches ~150-200 titles (was ~60 from 3 fixed categories). Much harder to exhaust.
Fixed: Player portrait title too small — increased from 14pt to 20pt.
Removed: Duplicate Apply Filter bar in Search — only one Apply button now.

Added: Module Settings icon in the Change Stream UI — tap the gear button to open the existing Module Settings page.
Fixed: Module expand/collapse bug — tapping a module now properly toggles it open/closed (was one-way: once open, couldn't close).
Fixed: Staff section disappearing from anime detail page when staff data was empty — now always shows the header with a clean empty state inside.
Fixed: Collection (bookmark) icon floating over the episode sort button — moved to a fixed toolbar position at the top of the screen.
Changed: Character Details UI upgraded — Description and 'Appears In' sections now use collapsible cards matching the Change Stream UI design.

Fixed: Long-press on anime posters no longer triggers the wrong card's menu when the poster is below Continue Watching. Each poster now has its own isolated long-press gesture.
Fixed: Surprise Me stops working after ~4 uses — was hitting AniList rate limits because every tap fired 3 fresh API calls. Now caches the result pool for 10 minutes, so repeated taps make zero network requests.
Fixed: Schedule details title — was a black bar overlay floating on top of the screen. Now displays the title inside the custom details UI itself.
Fixed: Schedule tab — removed the dark navigation bar that said 'Schedule' or 'Releases' at the top. The Schedule tab is now clean.
Changed: Schedule poster titles ~20% larger (14pt → 17pt).
Removed: Blue Appearance preset completely. If you had Blue selected, accent is automatically reset to Default.

Completely reworked Change Stream UI — replaced the default iOS list with a fully custom card-based design that matches the rest of the app. Each anime module shows as a card with icon, name, language, and quality badge. Streams show as cards with quality badges (1080p/720p/480p/HLS), soft-subtitle indicators, and selected-state checkmarks.

Fixed: Manga modules appearing in Anime Change Stream — the module list now filters to anime-only at the data source. Manga modules can never reach the anime stream picker.

Improved: Streams sorted by quality (HLS first, then 1080p → 720p → 480p → 360p). Module filter bar appears when you have 4+ anime modules installed.

Confirmed: Auto Pick Module is still gone — manual selection preserved.

Restored the original manual episode selection workflow. Click an episode → choose a module → choose a stream → watch. Long-press an episode → Change Stream → choose a different module and stream → watch. No automatic module or stream selection anywhere.

Removed: Auto Pick Module feature completely (no more auto-resolve + auto-play). Removed 'Auto-pick Last Stream' and 'Auto-pick Last Search Result' toggles from Settings → Streaming. Removed 'Use Default Extension Only' toggle from Settings → Search — the module picker now always shows every installed anime module.

Fixed: Change Stream button (long-press an episode) now works and opens the manual picker. Previously it did nothing because the auto-pick flow had already committed to a stream.

Renamed: App is now 'Shirox+' (springboard icon label, sidebar header, launch wordmark, About page, AltStore listing).
Fixed: Characters/Staff/Recommendations duplicate section titles (e.g. 'Characters Characters') removed — each section now has one header. All four sections (Characters, Staff, Recommendations, Videos) are collapsed by default on the anime detail page; tap the chevron to expand.
Fixed: Staff section not loading — now resolves the MAL id via IDMappingService when the preloaded media has no idMal. Videos section also benefits.
Fixed: Downloads — custom Anime Downloads page (progress ring, file info, Find/Share buttons, Retry/Cancel/Delete) now opens for every anime download tap. Previously opened the 'Offline Reading' page instead. Manga downloads unchanged.
Fixed: Watch Episode button — no longer shows a 'Loading…' spinner when you tap an episode. The button is always interactive; stream resolution happens off-screen.
Changed: Glow effects removed from regular text-heavy buttons (Surprise Me, Remove All Pending, Export Backup, module-store Install). Intentional glow on Modules, Sources, selector cards, and Toggles preserved.

FIXED: When AniList API is down, the app now falls back to Jikan/MAL for Home screen data (trending, seasonal, popular, top rated) and manga data (trending, popular). The carousel and sections will show data from MAL/Jikan when AniList is unavailable. When AniList comes back online, pull to refresh and it will switch back automatically.

Added: Anime Staff section — directors, producers, animators, composers from MAL/Jikan.
Added: Anime Videos section — PVs, trailers, openings, endings with YouTube links from MAL/Jikan.
Added: Character Animeography — 'Appears In' section on character detail showing all anime the character appears in.
Added: Voice Actor full profile — tapping a VA opens a detail page with their bio, birthday, website, and all anime roles.

Fixed: Downloaded anime — custom detail page now appears correctly. Root cause was DownloadedMediaSnapshotStore returning nil (no snapshot exists). Now has a 4-tier fallback: snapshot → DetailView offline, AniList ID → AniListDetailView, module href → DetailView, nothing → DownloadDetailView. Previously all no-snapshot downloads hit a blank page.

Changed: App renamed from 'Shirox' to 'shirox' (lowercase).
Fixed: Character descriptions — stripped Markdown formatting artifacts (__, ~~, !~, *, HTML tags) from MAL/Jikan text.
Fixed: Removed black navigation bar with character name from character detail page.
Fixed: Schedule posters increased from 56×80 to 84×112 to match notification poster size.

Changed: Characters and Recommendations moved ABOVE Episodes on the anime detail page — visible immediately without scrolling.
Changed: Anime character data source switched from AniList to MAL/Jikan — shows anime-specific character artwork (not manga). Falls back to AniList if unavailable. Manga unchanged.
Added: Character detail page — Quick Stats card with favourites, AniList ID, gender, age, blood type, alternative names.
Added: 'View on AniList' link on character detail when available.

Fixed: Manga poster percentage badge now matches anime's size.
Fixed: Anime poster image source — now uses AniList coverImage.extraLarge directly (was TVDBPosterImage which could show wrong artwork).
Fixed: Library anime tap — no longer opens blank page. Now opens AniListDetailView.
Fixed: Library list — removed duplicate personal rating (was shown on poster AND right side; now poster only).
Fixed: Notification section posters — all aligned in single straight line, modestly larger.
Changed: Library list posters increased from 70pt to 80pt wide.

Fixed: Downloaded anime now correctly shows the anime detail page with downloaded episodes. Two bugs were preventing the offline data from showing: (1) vm.load(item:) was being called even when offlineSnapshot was set, overwriting the offline data with an online fetch. (2) episodesSection was checking 'all hrefs empty' which could fail if the online load had already run. Both fixed.

Fixed: Downloaded anime now opens the full anime DetailView (with episode list, synopsis, characters, recommendations) instead of the old file-manager page. Uses offlineSnapshot to show downloaded episodes and play them from disk.
Removed: Dead code — UpdateSettingsPage, AnimeModulePreferenceTests, unused state variables, unused NavigationLink.

Fixed: Manga downloads — all manga download rows (in-progress, completed, failed) are now tappable and open the custom manga detail page with offline chapters loaded from disk.
Added: Structured diagnostic logging with deduplication. Logs now include feature, operation, provider, content ID, endpoint, HTTP status, error, and response snippets.
Fixed: Synopsis — increased line limit and lower threshold for Show More button.

Added: Manga batch download — selecting chapters and tapping the 'Download N' button now starts downloading selected chapters. Previously the download icon entered selection mode but there was no way to initiate the download.
Fixed: Chapter/episode invert and reset buttons are now 46×46 — same size as all other action buttons. Previously they were smaller.

Fixed: Manga AniList page — duplicate/broken download button removed. Moved download button to the action-button row (matching anime page). Removed dead-code duplicate in readButton.
Fixed: Manga edit button — wrong status ('Watching' instead of 'Reading') from the Library list's cross-provider edit sheet. Added missing progressUnit parameter.
Fixed: Manga edit button — stale status on fresh app launch. Privacy toggle now optimistically updates the local entry.
Fixed: Manga reader — scrolling up quickly no longer teleports/jumps between pages. Skips currentPage updates during active scroll, does a final pass after scrolling settles.
Fixed: Privacy sync for manga — onTogglePrivate now optimistically updates the local entry.

Added: People/social (Connections) button on individual manga AniList pages — opens relations + reading order, matching the anime page.
Fixed: Poster size now consistent across anime and manga sections on the Home screen — both use the same responsive card width (155pt iPhone / 190pt iPad).
Fixed: Continue Reading poster size now matches Trending Manga / All-Time Popular posters (was 130pt, now 155/190pt).
Changed: Removed 'View on AniList' from the long-press context menu on Home and Library (both anime and manga). The option remains in Continue Watching / Continue Reading sections unchanged.

FIXED: AniList 400 Bad Request — the anime and manga detail GraphQL queries requested 'alternativeSpoiler' on the voiceActors name field, but AniList's StaffName type does NOT have that field (only CharacterName does). This caused EVERY detail page request to return 400, which is why Characters and Recommendations never appeared. Removed the invalid field from both voiceActors blocks. Character name blocks correctly retain it.
FIXED: Characters and Recommendations now load correctly on all anime and manga detail pages.
FIXED: Notification custom UI 400 error — same root cause. The notification detail view calls the same detail query.

Fixed: Characters not appearing on Anime detail page — the self-fetch fallback in CharactersSection only triggered when preloaded was nil, but the parent VM always passes preloaded: vm.characters (a non-optional array that starts as []). Swift promotes [] to Optional([]) which is NOT nil — so the self-fetch never ran. Fixed by checking preloaded?.isEmpty ?? true.
Fixed: Recommendations not appearing — same root cause, same fix.
Fixed: Synopsis section redesigned — card-style background, proper line spacing, centered Show more/Show less button for long text.
Added: Loading spinner with 'Loading characters…' / 'Loading recommendations…' text while fetching.
Added: 'type' field to anime recommendations query so the type filter works correctly.
Graceful empty state — if no character/recommendation data exists on AniList, the section renders nothing instead of a broken look.

Fixed: Toast close button — root cause was .allowsHitTesting(false) on the container disabling ALL hit-testing. Completely reworked.
Fixed: Surprise Me pool exhaustion — resets exclusion list on API failure.
Fixed: Manga posters now same size as anime posters (image fills 2:3 card).
Fixed: Library alignment — removed double-padding causing misaligned rows.
Removed: Auto Pick Module feature completely (was causing long loading + CF errors).
Removed: Updates tab from Settings (Update Log replaces it).
Changed: Grid toggle separate from profile in top-right toolbar.
Added: AniList 400 error logging for diagnosis.

Fixed: Toast close (X) button — completely reworked using a ZStack with two non-overlapping layers. The X button is on a higher z-layer with its own explicit hit region, so taps always reach it and never the content button. Tapping X now immediately dismisses the toast.
Fixed: Library filter alignment — all controls now uniformly left-aligned. Removed the ScrollView wrapper that was causing some controls to appear centered while others hugged the left side.
Changed: Grid/list toggle moved to top-right corner of Library, right next to the profile button. Both are on the trailing edge of the navigation bar.
Fixed: Episode rows with 'Mixed' filler badge — removed .fixedSize that was causing the badge to misalign the episode text. All episode rows now align consistently regardless of badge presence.
Changed: Manga chapter section header reset button now matches anime's exactly (32×32, was 36×36). All manga header buttons now use the same styling as anime's episode header buttons.

Changed: Manga chapter layout now matches anime episode layout EXACTLY — same 40×40 circle, 14pt spacing, 14/12 padding, .callout font, card background, progress bar, play icon, and download button. No separate smaller design for manga anymore.
Changed: Search page restored to simpler design — removed the Surprise Me toolbar icon and the 18 category chips. Now just one simple 'Surprise Me' button that picks a random anime from trending/popular. No duplicates in the same session.
Fixed: Anime notification detail — HTTP 400 error fixed (guarded against invalid mediaId). Added 'Released X ago' and exact release date/time. All requested info now shows: title, cover, episode number, release time, countdown to next episode, status, schedule, progress, statistics.
Changed: Edit Entry and Modules buttons — both on the right side now. Modules first, Edit Entry at far right. Completely independent buttons.
Fixed: Library tab alignment — all filter items now uniformly left-aligned. Grid toggle removed from filter row and moved to top-right toolbar corner.

Fixed: Library filter row — buttons no longer go outside the screen. The row is now wrapped in a horizontal ScrollView so nothing ever gets cut off, even on narrow screens with long custom-list names.
Fixed: Sort By dropdown — no longer hugging the right side. All filter controls (Status, Sort, Grid toggle) are in a natural left-to-right order inside the scrollable row.
Fixed: Edit Entry and Modules buttons — completely separated. Edit Entry is now on the leading edge of the nav bar, Modules dropdown stays on the trailing edge. Each has its own independent button and menu.
Fixed: Surprise Me — now always accessible from the Search toolbar (not just the empty state). Randomization improved: fetches pages 1-3 and shuffles the pool before picking. No duplicate anime in the same session.
Added: Custom anime notification detail UI — tapping an anime notification now opens a polished custom screen showing episode number, release time, countdown to next episode, anime status, schedule, episode count/progress, and statistics.
Fixed: Toast close (X) button — now works consistently. Both the content area and the X button are SwiftUI Buttons (was .onTapGesture + Button, which caused gesture conflicts).
Added: Update Log page in Settings — replaces the old Updates tab with a clean, organized log of all changes grouped by version and category (Added, Fixed, Changed, Improved).

Fixed: anime detail pages now show Relations correctly even when the initial detail fetch fails. Previously, when you opened an anime from a list (Trending, Popular, etc.) and the full detail fetch failed (rate limit, network error), the page would show the preloaded data without any relations — so the Relations tab appeared empty even for anime like Attack on Titan that definitely have sequels. Now the Relations tab shows a 'Couldn't load relations — Tap to retry' button that re-fetches the full detail on tap. The hero/metadata/episodes remain visible during the retry.

Fixed: anime detail pages now load correctly from ALL categories (Trending, Popular, Top Rated, Browse, Search) — not just Recently Completed. The list queries (trending, popular, topRated, seasonal, browse) were fetching only basic fields (id, title, cover, banner, score, genres, description) — NO episodes, status, format, season, studios, or nextAiringEpisode. When you tapped an anime from these categories, the preloaded media had no episode count, so the Watch button was disabled and the page appeared broken. Recently Completed worked because its query fetches the full field set. Fix: updated ALL list queries to match Recently Completed's field set — episodes, duration, status, source, format, season, seasonYear, startDate, endDate, nextAiringEpisode, averageScore, popularity, genres, studios. The Watch button now works immediately from any category, even before the full detail fetch completes.
Also added: popularity field to the detail query so the Statistics section shows the Popularity row for all anime, not just those loaded from list queries that already had it.

Fixed: anime detail pages no longer return 400 Bad Request — the GraphQL query had a stray 'VO_EXPANDED' token (a leftover placeholder from a code-generation template) sitting inside the voiceActors field selection. AniList rejected every detail request with this token, causing 400 errors on most anime pages. Recently Completed was the only category that worked because it uses a different query that doesn't fetch characters/voice actors. This also fixes the cascading failure where repeated 400s tipped AniList into a real rate-limit, which then triggered the MAL fallback, which also failed for users not authenticated with MAL.
Fixed: MAL fallback now skips gracefully when the user isn't MAL-authenticated — previously every fallback attempt tried a token refresh that always failed, spamming logs and leaving pages broken with no data from either provider.
Added: in-flight request de-duplication for anime/manga detail pages — rapid repeated calls for the same ID now share a single network request instead of firing duplicates that burn through rate-limit budget.
Fixed: Library filter controls scaled up (38pt → 44pt height, larger padding/icons) for better tap comfort. Sort control now displays as a text label ('Sort: Recently Updated', 'Sort: Title', etc.) instead of an icon-only button, making the current sort state clear at a glance.
Fixed: Continue Reading (manga) — tapping a poster now reliably opens the correct manga. The previous Button-in-LazyHStack pattern had a SwiftUI gesture conflict where the Button's captured item could mismatch the visual position after view recycling. Switched to .contentShape + .onTapGesture which is stable across LazyHStack recycling.
Removed: MAL dual-source merge for Characters and Statistics. These features now source from AniList exclusively — no MAL fallback for the detail page (MAL's detail returns fewer fields, causing incomplete Statistics and no Characters data). MAL fallback for other purposes (provider-level rate-limit fallback for Watch flow) is a separate system and is unchanged.

Fixed: Library filter row — ALL controls (status filter, sort, grid/list toggle, Anime/Manga pills, source switcher pills) now share one unified capsule style via a shared libraryCapsuleStyle ViewModifier. Every control has the exact same height (38pt), padding (14/9), corner radius (Capsule), background (ultraThinMaterial + active tint), and stroke (1pt). No control has its own custom sizing anymore.
Fixed: tapping an anime in Library now ALWAYS navigates to DetailView (the page with episodes) — the AniListDetailView fallback is removed entirely. If the entry has no linked module, the title is auto-resolved through an installed anime module. If no module is installed or search fails, DetailView still opens and shows its own state. No exceptions, no branching to a different page type.
Fixed: Toast close (X) button now works correctly — the X button's tap region is separated from the toast body's tap gesture so tapping X always dismisses without triggering the toast's own action. Previously both lived in the same HStack with a parent .onTapGesture covering the entire card, causing SwiftUI hit-testing conflicts. Stale doc comment about removed swipe gestures also updated.

Fixed: inverting manga chapter order no longer opens the wrong chapter — tapping chapter 25 in inverted mode now correctly opens chapter 25 (was opening chapter 1 due to an index mismatch between display order and real chapter position).
Fixed: manga chapter rows now show the numbered circle again (matching anime's episode row style), with a green-filled checkmark variant for completed chapters — the previous batch's removal of the numbered circle was incorrect; anime keeps the circle and just changes its fill color and content for completed items.
Fixed: section-header action buttons (download, invert, reset) in the manga Chapters section resized from cramped 32×32 to 36×36 with ultraThinMaterial background, matching anime's episodes section header exactly.
Fixed: Library filter row redesigned — status filter, sort, and grid/list toggle now share a single calculated capsule style (same height, padding, corner radius, spacing) instead of each control sizing itself independently. Grid toggle moved from the navigation toolbar into the filter row so all list controls live together as one designed unit.
Fixed: tapping an anime in Library with no linked module source now auto-resolves the title through an installed anime module and routes directly to the episode-list page (DetailView) — previously these entries landed on the stats-only AniListDetailView with no way to watch. Falls back to AniListDetailView only when no anime module is installed or no search results match.

Fixed: Continue Chapter button on manga detail page no longer truncates to "Con…" — the hero button row was restructured so the primary button has full width (previously 5 fixed-width icon buttons crowded it).
Fixed: manga chapter rows now show a meaningful read/unread indicator (green checkmark for read, subtle outline circle for unread) instead of a redundant numbered circle pill that repeated the chapter number already shown in the title.
Added: long-press context menu on manga chapter rows to manually mark chapters as Read or Unread.
Removed: jump-to-latest-chapter button (low value, contributed to button row crowding).
Removed: connections/people toggle from manga detail page (relations are already shown above the chapters list, so the toggle just hid the chapters without adding new information).
Moved: download/select-mode, invert-order, and reset-progress actions from the hero button row into the Chapters section header as a section-local toolbar — colocated with the list they actually control.

Fixed: manga carousel now goes straight to AniList page with Statistics, no extra tap needed.
Fixed: manga Schedule tab tap now opens the live countdown page instead of a reading page.
Added: long-press menu on manga Schedule entries with Add to Planning, View Details, and View on AniList.
Fixed: image quality improved with high interpolation on all images.
Fixed: black bars removed from top of manga detail pages.
Added: Library tab now has a grid view toggle (poster grid with score %).
Fixed: Home bell icon now opens the full notifications screen with swipe, history, and clear-all.
Fixed: notification swipe gestures, long-press menu, and history now all work from the Home bell.
Fixed: toggle glow radius increased 50% across the entire app for better visibility.
Added: unified context menu on all anime and manga cards (Add to Planning/Watching/Completed, View Details, View on AniList).
Fixed: carousel image reverted to original correct zoom level.
Added: Recommended for You and Surprise Me on the Search tab.
Added: manga module store now includes novels alongside manga.
Fixed: failed downloads show clean 'Failed' label instead of truncated error text.
Added: Find File button on completed downloads opens the iOS Files app.
Fixed: downloaded episodes now show as individual rows instead of grouped by anime.
Fixed: HTML entities like " now decode properly in synopses.
Fixed: duplicate Background toggle removed from subtitle settings.
Fixed: manga source page now says Reading instead of Watching.
Added: manga page layout settings redesigned with visual preview cards.
Fixed: 2x speed hold no longer conflicts with swipe-down-to-dismiss in the video player.
Fixed: carousel Start Reading button text no longer truncated.
Fixed: Continue Reading cards changed to vertical poster format.
Fixed: manga Browse categories no longer show icons.
Added: score percentage badge on manga cards.
Fixed: Privacy toggle now syncs from AniList server.
Fixed: Continue Watching rebuilds from server data after reinstall.

Fixed privacy state syncing from AniList server. Fixed toggle/long-press Mark as Private sync. Fixed anime detail page content clipping. Fixed anime search results to navigate to AniList page. Removed Statistics from manga source page. Built full AniList manga detail page with Statistics. Fixed all toggles rendering white (now light grey). Fixed toggle glow effect. Changed Continue Reading manga cards to vertical poster format. Fixed carousel Start Reading button truncation. Fixed manga View Details to open source page. Fixed manga View on AniList to open distinct AniList page.

Fixed Downloads tab: tapping an in-progress or failed download now opens the anime's detail page instead of doing nothing. The offline episode list now shows all download states (downloading, pending, failed, completed) with the right badge on each row, so you can see at a glance what's still in progress. Batch downloads from the module detail page now correctly save the detail href so the offline detail view can re-enrich artwork and metadata later.
Restored native SwiftUI toggles, fixed manga module detection, reworked manga settings layouts, fixed update manifest to point to correct fork repo.
Reading Mode for manga, MAL search source, Mark as Private, content safety cleanup, and streamlined IPA-only build pipeline.

Long-press the Shirox icon on your Home Screen for instant shortcuts. Jump straight to Search, Downloads, or Library — the app opens right onto the tab you picked, whether it was already running or fully closed. The shortcut icons match the tab bar, so it's a fast way into whatever you use most.

Download manga chapters for offline reading — grab a single chapter with one tap, or flip on selection mode to download a whole range in one batch, right from the manga's detail screen. Every chapter row shows live download progress and a checkmark when it's done, and downloaded chapters read completely offline with pages loading straight from your device. The Downloads tab has a new Manga section grouped by source and title, so you can open a saved manga and read it fully offline. Also fixed: deleting a download now cleans up every file it leaves behind, removed downloads no longer redownload themselves after a relaunch, and downloaded episodes recover on their own after the app's been backgrounded.

news.title: New in 1.9 - Downloads tab tap-to-open fix
news.caption: Tapping any in-progress or failed download in the Downloads tab now opens the anime's detail page. The offline episode list shows every download state with the right badge, so you always know what's still downloading, what failed, and what's ready to play.

news.title: New in 1.5 - Native toggles, manga fixes, update system
news.caption: Toggles are back to native SwiftUI switches. Manga module detection fixed so chapters load correctly when a module is installed. Update system now fetches from the correct fork repo. Manga settings tabs reworked with unique layouts.

news.title: New in 1.4 - Reading Mode & MAL support
news.caption: Full Reading Mode for manga with dedicated home, search, schedule, and settings. MyAnimeList support as a search source. Mark as Private for library entries. Streamlined IPA-only build pipeline.
